FM15.reasoning: The agent only calculates and reports accuracy, without verifying if this metric is appropriate given potential class imbalance in the ratings.

other_failure_modes.name: Optimizing discontinuous metric for ensembling
other_failure_modes.description: The agent optimizes ensemble weights by directly minimizing negative accuracy (which relies on an argmax operation). Since accuracy is a non-smooth step function, optimization algorithms like Nelder-Mead can easily get stuck in local flat regions where small weight changes do not alter predictions. It is standard practice to optimize a continuous proxy metric like log-loss instead.

summary: The agent implements a robust cross-validated solution with text-based feature extraction and an ensemble of multiple classification models. The primary issues are its reliance on a single metric (accuracy) without checking for class imbalance, and an improper optimization objective for ensembling, as Nelder-Mead will struggle to optimize a discontinuous function like accuracy.
